sceneConcept: An energetic twenty-six-year-old Chinese esports-hall proprietor stands alone against a transparent background. Shoulder-length springy permed curls flow from dark roots through cyan, magenta and purple, framing brown eyes and an animated friendly face. She wears a loose color-block bomber jacket with cyan and magenta panels over a plain black t-shirt, charcoal cargo trousers and scuffed high-top sneakers. Compact black headphones rest around her neck while both open hands gesture rapidly at chest height as she talks. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the colorful silhouette clean.
